info.title: WebBlock Project API
info.description: The user REST API of the Project service, generated from the code in the prototype profile. Notion "Web Block architecture" section 2 stays the authority for the API contract. Every success body is wrapped in the envelope {success, data, meta}; the schemas here show the data before the wrapping. Errors are RFC 9457 Problem Details.

bearer.description: A Keycloak access token with audience project, or a dev token of the prototype profile
